finding.name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in a Command ('Command Injection')
finding.summary: The requesterEmail request parameter flows unsanitized from TicketController through TicketSubmission and TicketNotificationService's MailEnvelope into SmtpRelayClient, where it is concatenated into a hand-built SMTP MAIL FROM command line written to a raw Socket, letting an address containing CRLF inject an additional SMTP command into the session.
